cli.autoAcceptTitle: Runs on its own, without asking
cli.autoAcceptBody: {{harness}} runs non-interactively and accepts every action it decides to take inside the working directory, without asking you first. When the agent has the Files tool, its file changes go through Comitiva's approvals instead.
cli.nativeToolsWarning: {{harness}}'s own file edits cannot be turned off. When the agent has the Files tool, Comitiva runs it with a read-only sandbox so every write goes through your approval; otherwise its edits happen directly, limited only by its sandbox.
cli.messageStreaming: Replies arrive one message at a time, not word by word.
cli.binaryHint: Leave blank to find it on PATH and in the usual install locations.
cli.workingDirectoryHint: Leave blank to give each conversation its own folder in Comitiva's data folder.

sandboxHelp.workspace-write: Codex can read anywhere and write only inside the working directory, enforced by the OS.
sandboxHelp.read-only: Codex can read but not change files or run commands that write.
sandboxHelp.danger-full-access: No OS sandbox: Codex can change anything your user account can. Use it only when the sandbox cannot start on this system.

ask.label: Ask before changes
ask.hint: Reading runs freely; writes, moves and deletes wait for your approval.

allow-writes.label: Allow changes
allow-writes.hint: Every tool runs without asking. Only for agents and folders you trust.

read-only.label: Read only
read-only.hint: Tools that change things are not offered at all.

generic.name: Generic Assistant
generic.role: You are a helpful, careful assistant. Answer clearly and concisely, ask a short clarifying question when a request is ambiguous, and say so when you are not sure about something instead of guessing.

researcher.name: Researcher
researcher.role: You are a researcher. Break questions into parts, gather information from the sources available to you, compare them, and separate facts from interpretation. Cite where each claim comes from, point out gaps or conflicting evidence, and end with a short summary of what is known and what is not.

writer.name: Writer
writer.role: You are a writer. Turn ideas, notes and drafts into clear, well-structured text for the intended audience. Match the requested tone and length, prefer plain words and short sentences, and when the brief is thin, propose an outline before writing the full piece.

reviewer.name: Reviewer
reviewer.role: You are a reviewer. Read the material you are given carefully and give specific, actionable feedback: what works, what is unclear, what is wrong or missing, and how to fix it. Order your points by importance and quote the exact passage each one refers to.

fileOrganizer.name: File Organizer
fileOrganizer.role: You are a file organizer. Help keep folders tidy: look at what is there, propose a clear structure and consistent names, and explain the plan before moving, renaming or deleting anything. Never remove files without saying exactly which ones and why.

drive.disconnectBody: Comitiva forgets the sign-in and asks Google to revoke it. Agents that use Drive stop until you connect again. Your files are not touched.

setup.title: Google OAuth client
setup.intro: Comitiva does not ship Google credentials: you create your own OAuth client once, and it stays on this computer.

steps.project: In Google Cloud Console, create a project (or pick one).
steps.api: Enable the Google Drive API for it.
steps.consent: Configure the OAuth consent screen: “External” in Testing with yourself as a test user (or “Internal” on Google Workspace), with the …/auth/drive scope.
steps.client: Create an OAuth client ID of type “Desktop app”.
steps.paste: Paste its client ID and secret here, save, then Connect.

setup.guide: Step-by-step guide: docs/tools.md → Google Drive. In Testing, Google asks you to sign in again every 7 days.
setup.clientSecretHint: Stored in the system keyring, never shown again. Leave blank to keep the stored one.
setup.changesAccount: A different client disconnects the current Google account.
